item.title: Quote for book design
item.description:
I have been asked to provide a quote for the cover design and typesetting of three young adult novels. The books are all around 150 pages. Any ideas on how much I should quote for the whole project?

Any guidance you could give me would be greatly appreciated.

item.title: Type Design: Freelance Pricing Advice
item.description: I am a designer, and over the past 2 years I have created several typefaces (Latin 9). I have done this at my salaried job. I also do freelance design and have recently been asked to give someone a quote for a Latin 9 San-serif character set. Does anyone out there have a general pricing guide they use for freelance type design?
